Up close it resolves into a shaded garden alcove, with leaves arching overhead. This was the world Mariano Fortuny inhabited in 1940, in the final years of a long caree r as artist, inventor, and dreamer — a world in which the decorative and the visionary were inseparable. The scalloped structure of ARBORETO carries the formal precision of Art Deco design: curved forms arranged with architectural regularity, botanical m otifs held within a geometric discipline. The large repeat makes it ideal for expansive walls and generous drapery where the full canopy of the design can be perceived. Part of the WAKE INTO THE DREAM collection .
